newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ dollar ends slightly softer after light trade.
newsitem.headline: NZ dollar ends slightly softer after light trade.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar closed slightly softer on Monday after trading lightly in a tight range in a market firmly in holiday mode.
The Kiwi ended at US$0.7073/80 from its 0.7081/88 opening while on its Trade-Weighted Index, it ended at 67.39 from 67.52.
Dealers said the Kiwi traded a 0.7068-82 range and they doubt it will stray far from that overnight or on Tuesday.
A $200 million eurokiwi issued on Friday by the World Bank was of interest but caused no market reaction.
